name: namecraft-ecom
description: NameCraft — personalized name-plate customization e-commerce platform (MERN). Separate customer + admin frontends, one shared Express/Mongo backend.

scripts.build: npm --prefix client-customer run build && npm --prefix client-admin run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client-customer install && npm --prefix client-admin install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client-customer run lint && npm --prefix client-admin run lint
